sources.label: Clean, ad-free Morphe patches for popular Android apps.

patch_list: Hide playback controls at stream open
Hides controls when a stream opens or switches fullscreen. Tap the video to show them.
Improves remote focus and opens playback controls with OK on Android TV.
Remove configured startup and banner ads
Suppresses configured startup/banner ads, the Telegram prompt and message ticker.
